profile: Whitehawk Therapeutics is a clinical-stage oncology therapeutics company developing antibody-drug conjugates for cancer. Its licensed pipeline includes candidates targeting PTK7, MUC16, and SEZ6, using a linker-payload platform designed to deliver a topoisomerase I inhibitor into cancer cells. Whitehawk’s lead candidates are in early clinical development for solid tumors, including lung, ovarian, and endometrial cancers.
